deal.name: Glow
deal.lead_investors: CyberStarts(Gili Raanan), Greenoaks, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital(Shaun Maguire)

subcategories.label: Lead tier
subcategories.finding: Sequoia (Tier 1+) co-leads with CyberStarts, Greenoaks, Redpoint at Series B[1].

subcategories.label: New vs re-up
subcategories.finding: Sequoia/CyberStarts re-up from Seed; Redpoint new but non-Tier-1[2].

subcategories.label: Stage fit
subcategories.finding: $1.2B post-money Series B/B-1, clean up-round primary[2].

subcategories.label: Domain-strategic
subcategories.finding: Leads are financial VCs, not domain operators; no strategic asymmetry.

subcategories.label: Lead conviction
subcategories.finding: Sequoia's Shaun Maguire[3] and CyberStarts' Gili Raanan (Wiz, Cyera) drove deal[4].

subcategories.label: Institutional momentum
subcategories.finding: Sequoia, CyberStarts, Greenoaks all followed on from Seed/A[2].

subcategories.label: Existing Tier 1
subcategories.finding: Sequoia (Tier 1+) and Greenoaks (Tier 1) pre-round[2].

subcategories.label: Timing/motivation
subcategories.finding: No disclosed term-sheet competition; rapid 3x re-rate suggests momentum.

params.evidence: Tier-1+ Sequoia is present but re-upping, not new money; the only new-money co-lead, Redpoint, isn't Tier-1 — thesis pattern only partially met.

subcategories.label: Prior exit
subcategories.finding: Tiger co-founded Onavo, acquired by Meta for ~$120-200M[5].

subcategories.label: Domain authority
subcategories.finding: Singer led Snowflake security strategy; Arie ran Claroty R&D, Unit 8200[1].

subcategories.label: Team complement
subcategories.finding: CEO/CTO/R&D founders plus ex-Meta CPO, ex-CISO COO cover functions[1][6].

subcategories.label: Recruiting power (as in team growth)
subcategories.finding: ~100 hires in a year, incl. ex-CISO and ex-Meta leaders[1][6].

subcategories.label: Public presence
subcategories.finding: Singer/Tiger have prior press and blog visibility; Glow itself was stealth[5].

subcategories.label: Integrity
subcategories.finding: Onavo later used in Meta's 'Ghostbusters' spying scheme; Tiger not personally named[5][7].

params.evidence: Deep, complementary security pedigree (Snowflake, Claroty, Unit 8200) and a real prior exit; Tiger's Onavo carries an unresolved privacy-scandal shadow.

subcategories.label: Ownership of models
subcategories.finding: Runs Anthropic/Gemini via Bedrock plus a proprietary context layer[6][8].

subcategories.label: Data flywheel / Recurssion
subcategories.finding: Claims cross-device 'single source of truth'; no usage-compounding evidence public[8].

params.evidence: AI is central to the pitch but currently an orchestration/context layer atop rented foundation models, not an owned architecture or proven data flywheel.

subcategories.label: Just assume they are good (unless there's something public)
subcategories.finding: Primary Series B co-invest; no adverse terms reported publicly.

params.evidence: No public information on ID8's specific terms; assume standard 0/0/10 economics absent any disclosed adverse signal.

subcategories.label: Revenue/growth
subcategories.finding: [ESTIMATED] ~$10-20M ARR via Cyera's 80x comp multiple[9][10].

subcategories.label: NDR
subcategories.finding: NDR not disclosed; no comparable-peer estimate found.

subcategories.label: Margins/unit econ
subcategories.finding: LTV/CAC and gross margin undisclosed; no usable estimate.

subcategories.label: Burn/runway
subcategories.finding: Burn undisclosed; $178M raised to date, no runway data[2].

subcategories.label: Customer concentration
subcategories.finding: Customers span healthcare, retail, finance; concentration % undisclosed[1][6].

subcategories.label: Pref stack
subcategories.finding: Cap table shows pari passu prefs; full stack undisclosed[2].

subcategories.label: Moat durability
subcategories.finding: Cross-device data/telemetry moat claimed; no usage evidence published[8].

subcategories.label: Market/TAM
subcategories.finding: Endpoint security ~$40B now, $119B by 2035; AI-agent layer emerging[11].

subcategories.label: Valuation vs comps
subcategories.finding: [ESTIMATED] multiple (~60-120x ARR) richer than Cyera's already-frothy 80x[9].

subcategories.label: Sector risk
subcategories.finding: CrowdStrike/Microsoft/SentinelOne shipping rival AI features fast; real but not fatal[12].

params.evidence: No disclosed financials; [ESTIMATED] ~$10-20M ARR via Cyera comp implies a very rich entry multiple despite a large, still-forming TAM.

subcategories.label: Entry multiple
subcategories.finding: Growth/margin trajectory unconfirmed; entry multiple can't be judged.

subcategories.label: Base-case MOIC
subcategories.finding: Rich entry vs. estimated ARR caps realistic base-case upside.

subcategories.label: Exit path
subcategories.finding: Sector precedent: Wiz-Google $32B[13], Cyera $12B[10], CrowdStrike/SentinelOne IPOs.

subcategories.label: Dilution
subcategories.finding: Modeled 2 rounds at ~20-25% each; case stays viable.

subcategories.label: Time to liquidity
subcategories.finding: Comps (Cyera) moved Series B to $12B in 3yrs[10].

subcategories.label: Downside protection
subcategories.finding: Pari passu, non-participating preferred, weighted-average anti-dilution confirmed[2].

subcategories.label: Exit multiples
subcategories.finding: Same-category comps exist but may reflect cycle-peak AI pricing[9][10].

subcategories.label: Secondary demand
subcategories.finding: Too new post-stealth for any secondary market signal yet.

params.evidence: Strong exit precedent (Wiz, Cyera, CrowdStrike) and modelable dilution, but a rich unconfirmed entry multiple caps realistic base-case MOIC below 6x.

model_output.rationale: Elite Israeli security team and Sequoia/CyberStarts backing are real, but Sequoia is a re-up, not new money, and new-money co-lead Redpoint is non-Tier-1 — missing ID8's core predictor. AI still runs atop rented Anthropic/Gemini models, priced richly against undisclosed revenue.
